# GR02-review-message-chunks: A read-only Review with a picked model (`grok agent --model grok-4.6 --no-leader stdio`): session/new with the ask posture (_meta yoloMode false, autoMode false), no set_mode (Grok has none). A read runs unasked; a thought (logged, never printed), Grok's own x.ai/session_notification (ignored) and the answer as agent_message_chunk text; the prompt answer carries no ACP usage, its _meta.usage.modelUsage is the pass usage (cached reads apart, exact) and Grok's own cost.
# A signed-in profile; --model is the model to stamp (any the account offers).
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.grok.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor grok --grok-home "<fixture GROK_HOME>" --bin "<the grok executable>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/grok/acp/GR02-review-message-chunks --id GR02 --slug review-message-chunks --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR02-review-message-chunks/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR02-review-message-chunks/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/grok/recipes/GR02-review-message-chunks/responders.mjs --timeout 900000 -- agent --model grok-4.6 --no-leader stdio
